title: Keep susi-gemi under its lean-core line ceiling: move the openrouter provider test out of src
goal: The Linux qualification of release snapshot v0-21-54-rc1 (57dfb2e78) failed lean_core_ceilings::pillar_source_does_not_grow: susi-gemi measured 21305 shipped lines under src against the ceiling 21290, because T-CLAUDETESTFIX-1 (364600b95) enlarged an inline unit test in src/openrouter_ext.rs. Ceilings only go down, so the test moves to its own integration binary crates/susi-gemi/tests/openrouter_provider.rs (suite dirs are not counted). In its own process it cannot race sibling unit tests that move HOME, which removes the cause of the flake structurally; it still uses an isolated EnvGuard home and a fixed test key.
